principle.name: Backup First
principle.description: Always create backups before performing bulk file operations
principle.rationale: Prevents data loss from accidental deletions or incorrect operations

example.good: Use cp -r or rsync to create backup directory first
example.bad: Proceed directly with mv commands without backup

principle.name: Test on Samples
principle.description: Test organization logic on small sample before full execution
principle.rationale: Identifies issues early and prevents widespread problems

example.scenario: Creating new naming scheme for documents
example.good: Test renaming logic on 3-5 sample files first
example.bad: Apply new scheme to all 500 files immediately

principle.name: Preserve Metadata
principle.description: Maintain file creation dates and other metadata when possible
principle.rationale: Preserves chronological context and search capabilities

example.scenario: Moving files to new organization structure
example.good: Use mv -p or cp -p to preserve timestamps
example.bad: Use basic cp/mv which may change modification times

convention.rule: Use descriptive, searchable names with key information
Use ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) for consistency
Use clear category prefixes or folder structures

pattern.name: chronological
pattern.description: Organize by date for time-sensitive documents

pattern.name: categorical
pattern.use_case: HR documents, financial records, project files

pattern.name: entity_based
pattern.description: Organize by company, client, or project
pattern.use_case: Client work, vendor documents, project deliverables

pattern.name: hybrid
pattern.use_case: Complex document libraries with multiple access patterns

pitfall.why_problematic: Makes navigation difficult and files hard to find
pitfall.correct_approach: Limit to 3-4 levels maximum, use clear naming
Establish and follow strict naming conventions

pitfall.why_problematic: Can corrupt files or lose original versions
pitfall.correct_approach: Always work on copies for analysis, modify originals only after validation

guidance.practice: Use find and xargs for batch operations safely
Check file types with 'file' command before processing
Use exiftool for comprehensive metadata extraction
Verify OCR accuracy on sample pages first
